posts.title: 21shares lists Europe's first Anthropic pre-IPO ETP
posts.excerpt: European investors can now trade Anthropic's implied pre-IPO valuation through the 21shares Anthropic Synthetic ETP (ticker CLAU), listed on the Vienna MTF, per 21shares' announcement. The exposure…
posts.body: European investors can now trade Anthropic's implied pre-IPO valuation through the 21shares Anthropic Synthetic ETP (ticker CLAU), listed on the Vienna MTF, per [21shares' announcement](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/13/3379343/0/en/21shares-launches-europe-s-first-pre-ipo-synthetic-anthropic-etp.html). The exposure is purely synthetic, built on swaps tracking a Kaiko index of Binance perpetual futures rather than any Anthropic shares.

posts.title: CWS: custody over 6 months as child deportation orders top 10,000
posts.excerpt: Answering the October 1 HHS report, Church World Service says sponsor-reunification policy changes have made release nearly impossible, pushing the average custody stay to over six months, citing…
posts.body: Answering the October 1 HHS report, Church World Service says sponsor-reunification policy changes have made release nearly impossible, pushing the average custody stay to [over six months](https://cwsglobal.org/press-releases/new-hhs-report-on-unaccompanied-children-overlooks-harm-caused-by-current-policies/), citing government data. In one case it describes, a father who finished every sponsor-vetting protocol was detained and deported by ICE two days before reuniting with his son.

posts.title: Trump calls Houthis 'misbehaving' as Riyadh flights halt
posts.excerpt: Repeated Houthi missile attacks on Saudi airports, Riyadh's King Khalid International and Dammam's King Fahd International among them, have killed at least 18 people, and Riyadh's airport is shut…
posts.body: Repeated Houthi missile attacks on Saudi airports, Riyadh's King Khalid International and Dammam's King Fahd International among them, have killed at least 18 people, and Riyadh's airport is shut through Saturday, [per Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/liveblog/2026/10/13/iran-war-live-trump-says-houthis-misbehaving-as-riyadh-flights-halted). Airlines are pulling out in turn: Etihad cancelled all Abu Dhabi–Riyadh flights through October 19, and Qatar Airways suspended its Riyadh and Dammam service.

posts.title: FCC approves SpaceX's 15,000-satellite direct-to-device network
posts.excerpt: On October 7, the FCC cleared nine very-low-Earth-orbit shells from 326 to 335 km for what SpaceX calls Starlink Mobile, using spectrum acquired from EchoStar plus supplemental coverage-from-space…
posts.body: On October 7, the FCC cleared nine very-low-Earth-orbit shells from 326 to 335 km for what SpaceX calls Starlink Mobile, using spectrum acquired from EchoStar plus supplemental coverage-from-space spectrum, per [Via Satellite](https://www.satellitetoday.com/connectivity/2026/10/07/fcc-grants-spacex-approval-for-15000-direct-to-device-satellites-in-mss-spectrum/). The next generation starts launching next year for service by year-end, a leap past the roughly 650 satellites carrying the current direct-to-device offering.

posts.title: Two Americans win Nobel economics prize for boom-bust research
posts.excerpt: Robert E. Hall of Stanford and Michael Woodford of Columbia won the 2026 Nobel economics prize for the "microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation." Their work showed that boom-bust…
posts.body: Robert E. Hall of Stanford and Michael Woodford of Columbia [won the 2026 Nobel economics prize](https://www.khsu.org/2026-10-12/two-americans-win-nobel-prize-in-economics-for-work-on-boom-bust-cycles) for the "microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation." Their work showed that boom-bust cycles run on what households and firms expect, making a central bank's plain talk about its plans a stabilisation tool in itself.

posts.title: Stopping sets early beats grinding for jump and sprint
posts.excerpt: A Frontiers in Physiology meta-analysis of 12 randomized controlled trials, published October 6, found that stopping sets when rep speed dipped about 10% produced better jump and sprint gains than…
posts.body: A [Frontiers in Physiology meta-analysis](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2026.1893020/full) of 12 randomized controlled trials, published October 6, found that stopping sets when rep speed dipped about 10% produced better jump and sprint gains than pushing through to 30-40% velocity loss. The 10%-loss group added 9.2% to countermovement jump against 5.4% for the 30%-loss group, while doing less than half the total reps.

posts.body: Published Oct 11, 2026, 11:30 AM. The [report behind the chatter](https://tech-insider.org/nvidia-ends-rtx-5090-production-rtx-pro-gb202-2026/) traces the claim to hardware leakers MEGAsizeGPU and hongxing2020 and an alleged factory notice saying Nvidia will stop building RTX 5090 cards and reserve GB202 silicon for RTX Pro, and Nvidia has issued no confirmation. posts.title: Jailbroken PS5s can now dump PS2 discs straight from the drive
posts.excerpt: PS5SX2 2.01 lets a jailbroken PS5 read a PS2 disc in its own drive, dump it to the console SSD or an external HDD, and launch the game, with no PC ripping or downloaded ROMs. The catch is the drive…
posts.body: [PS5SX2 2.01](https://thedailygame.news/story/2026-10-10-ps5sx2-emulator-update-lets-jailbroken-ps5s-read-and-dump-ps2-discs-dire--5fc55541) lets a jailbroken PS5 read a PS2 disc in its own drive, dump it to the console SSD or an external HDD, and launch the game, with no PC ripping or downloaded ROMs. The catch is the drive itself: it reads Blu-rays and DVDs but not CDs, so blue-tinted CD-format PS2 discs and all PS1 discs stay unreadable.

posts.title: DHS offers migrant children $3,000 for voluntary departure
posts.excerpt: Bloomberg Law reported October 9 that ICE attorneys and some immigration judges are offering migrant children as young as 5 a $3,000 incentive to take voluntary departure, up from a $2,500 offer…
posts.body: [Bloomberg Law reported October 9](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/us-law-week/dhs-offers-migrant-children-3-000-to-voluntarily-depart-us) that ICE attorneys and some immigration judges are offering migrant children as young as 5 a $3,000 incentive to take voluntary departure, up from a $2,500 offer limited to teens 14 and older. Legal aid groups call it coercion: some children are asked to decide on the spot, at times without a lawyer, waiving asylum or other relief for the payment.

posts.title: JetBrains ships Mellum2.1, a fast open model for coding agents
posts.excerpt: JetBrains' new coding model is a 12-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts build that activates only 2.5B parameters per token, under the Apache 2.0 license. The upgrade over Mellum2 came almost…
posts.body: [JetBrains' new coding model](https://blog.jetbrains.com/ai/2026/10/mellum2-1-gets-to-work-a-fast-open-model-for-coding-agents/) is a 12-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts build that activates only 2.5B parameters per token, under the Apache 2.0 license. The upgrade over Mellum2 came almost entirely from reinforcement learning inside real repositories, millions of sandboxed runs, rather than from any change to the architecture.

posts.title: Brownsville advances 90-day data center moratorium after final hearing
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 8, 2026, morning: Brownsville's City Commission approved Ordinance No. 2026-1826 on first reading after the third and final public hearing, temporarily pausing acceptance, processing…
posts.body: Published Oct 8, 2026, morning: Brownsville's City Commission approved Ordinance No. 2026-1826 on first reading after the third and final public hearing, temporarily pausing acceptance, processing and approval of data-center applications in the city and its extraterritorial jurisdiction ([Texas Border Business](https://texasborderbusiness.com/brownsville-city-commissions-second-public-hearing-regarding-data-center-moratorium/)). The ordinance returns for second and final reading November 4, where it needs a three-fourths vote, and if approved the 90-day moratorium runs November 5 through February 3, 2027.
